name: Couple Interactions
description: Everyday cooperation and contact between two adults. Entries name separate roles, supports and hand placement without assigning gender or a relationship.
entries: Two people standing on opposite sides of a window, one inside and one outside, raising open palms toward each other through the glass.
One person holding a measuring tape against a wall while the other marks its upper end with a pencil.
Two people seated across a game board, one moving a piece while the other watches with hands resting beside the board.
One person holding a bicycle upright by its handlebars while the other crouches beside a wheel to inspect it.
Two people stretching a cloth between them, each gripping two corners with arms apart.
One person seated with their back toward the other, who stands behind them and gathers their hair with both hands.
Two people seated on opposite ends of a bench, turning toward each other with their feet on the ground.
One person holding a ladder steady at its base while the other stands on a low rung, keeping one hand on the rail.
Two people standing back-to-back with their shoulders lightly touching, each looking ahead in the opposite direction and supporting their own weight.
One person standing behind the other person with arms loosely around their waist, both facing the same direction and standing on their own feet.
Two people facing each other with foreheads gently touching, their feet planted apart enough to lean forward without losing balance.
Handshake: two people standing face-to-face at arm's length, each extending one hand to clasp the other's hand between them.
High five: two people facing each other with one arm raised each, their open palms meeting above shoulder level.
One person seated while the other person stands beside them, leaning slightly toward the same open page and pointing to a detail on it.
Two people standing on opposite sides of a large box, each gripping their own side with both hands and bending their knees to share its weight.
One person standing on a lower step and reaching up to the other person, who braces on the upper step and offers a hand without lifting them off their feet.
Two people seated side by side, one holding an open map across their lap while the other points to a place on it.
One person holding a small object out on an open palm while the other person reaches toward it, their hands separated enough to show the exchange.
Two people kneeling on opposite sides of a shared workpiece, one holding it steady while the other works on its near edge.
Two people walking side by side in the same direction, one turning their head toward the other while both keep space for their strides.
